subject: RetroPlug/LSDJ exception and Ember King chiptune theme
question: Owner-directed tool installation and explicit UVI-rule exception
decision: Install RetroPlug to use the already downloaded LSDJ for Game Boy tones. This is an explicit exception to the UVI-only instrument rule. Chiptune is the theme for the Ember King. Other instrumentation retains the existing UVI/Sunbird direction; tool/genre authorization does not establish a finished composition, runtime replacement or release acceptance.
